_about: Spoken prompts for the M0 voice benchmark (VISION §11.2, §25). no_lookup: Atlas can answer from what it knows. lookup: it has to check a tool first. Edit freely; ids name the cached audio files.

scenarios.text: Should I have coffee or tea this afternoon?
What's two hundred times thirty five?
Tell me one interesting thing about octopuses.
Give me a one line pep talk.
Do I have anything this afternoon?
Remind me to stretch in twenty minutes.
What reminders do I have coming up?
